logo_override.validation_detail: png 145x53, probed HTTP 200 with content-type image/png (4565 bytes). Pixel analysis: 48.2% transparent, 0.0% near-white among opaque pixels, 22.3% near-black, mean opaque rgb(192,1,54) - i.e. TU Graz's crimson plus black text, not a white wordmark. Rendered on a white background and visually confirmed as the full TU Graz lockup: the red pixel-grid device beside 'TU' in black with 'Graz' set beneath it. Reads clearly on a light card.
logo_override._award: TU Graz High Potentials Scholarship Programme

notes: Awarding body is TU Graz (Graz University of Technology), so a TU Graz mark is correct. This shard was flagged in the shard file as has_any_image=true with current_image_kind='program_image', and that stored image is indeed wrong: the scholarship page at www.tugraz.at is full of editorial photography - csm_F-LU-24-BtF-INFF-LNF-by-Lunghammer-tugraz-208, csm_ATCOLD_Jalal_Idrees_1, csm_APG_Walter_1, csm_Vanesa-Kurtovic-by-Lunghammer-tugraz_0, csm_Banner_TUGraz100 - none of which is a logo, so this override replaces programme imagery with the institutional mark. Discovery: www.tugraz.at ships its header logo as an INLINE svg with class int-header-logo-img and no probeable src, and grepping their aggregated stylesheets (style.css, int.css, media.css, print.css under /_assets/<hash>/Css/) surfaced no logo asset references at all, so the www host yields nothing citable under rule 5. I then followed brief section 2.3 to other TU Graz services on the same registrable domain. bigmail.tugraz.at and security.tugraz.at both load static.tugraz.at/static/intranet/1.0/images/logo.png with alt text 'Logo of TU Graz', and that is what I probed and rendered. The naming convention there is the useful part and it is exactly the rule-3 trap: logo.png is the positive crimson version while logo_invers.png is the reversed white one (I probed it too - 22.3% near-white, 0.0% near-black - and rendering it on white confirms the wordmark disappears, so it is rejected). Rejected also: live.learninglab.tugraz.at/static/images/logo_tug_rosa.png (alt 'TU Graz Logo', 200 image/png 958 bytes, but only 75x29 and in a different magenta-pink, mean rgb(179,1,51)) and the clearly non-TU-Graz partner marks on the scholarship page itself, fileadmin/user_upload/tugrazInternal/Home/TU-Austria.png (alt 'TU Austria Logo') and fileadmin/user_upload/tugrazInternal/Footer/unite_logo.png (alt 'unite-university Logo') - TU Austria and Unite are partner institutions in the TU Austria alliance, so under rule 2 they are not the body awarding this TU Graz scholarship. Host check: static.tugraz.at is a subdomain of the shard host tugraz.at, satisfying rule 1 directly.
